reviews.title: Amazing!
reviews.comment: This liquid cooling system has got to be the best cooling system that I have used up to date. I purchased this for my new build using an Asus mobo, pentium i9 ultimate cpu, and an Asus 5080 graphics card. With this cpu liquid cooling system my cpu runs about 92 degrees Fahrenheit and under stress it goes up to about 108, then cools back down. I have not seen my cpu go above 115 degrees even under heavy gaming and video. Amazing! As for installation... it was a breeze. The hardest part was applying the thermal paste. Not hard at all. The magnetic fans are so easy to install its almost effortless.

reviews.title: It's a cooler
reviews.comment: Worth the price? No Does it cool? Yes Is it cool? Subjective My old Lian Li galahad 360 died on me so I had to get a new one and as you can see it had to be a white one. Looked at a million different options when I saw this one. And since I already have a ROG motherboard and ROG gpu this was going to pair nicely with the rest of the system. Don't mind the cables the ones that are attached to the pump/waterblock are a bit long but not long enough to run through the back of the case. Anyways if you can stomach the price it's a great AIO.
reviews.author: Shawn hill

reviews.title: Repacked Product but otherwise works GREAT!!
reviews.comment: Barring the fact the product come to me used or repackaged, the product itself works great.  I had a NXTZ 280 AIO but I didn't like that I was getting 94-95c max package temps (in Cinebench 2024) so I wanted to try this ASUS Ryuo III. Note I also undervolted the PC a little. I'm running an intel 14900k spec'd for creator content (not gaming) but this helped being down the temps by 4-5c. Here are some benchmarks I've done with Cinebench 2024 and R23. Pushed it down further by applying Thermal Grizzly Kyronaut Extreme Thermal Paster. Hope this helps: With NXTZ 280 ARGB AIO - 94-95c Max, 80c Average. Cinebench 2024 * Asus Ryuo III - Default Paste: 85c Max, 80c Average (Score: 2104) * Reapplied with Thermal Grizzly Kryonaut Thermal Paste: 83c Max, 73c Average (I manually calculated the average as I forgot to reset the min/max when I started the benchmark) Cinebench R23 * Asus Ryuo III - Default Paste: 84c Max, 78c Average (Score: 37037) (I manually calculated the average as I forgot to reset the min/max when I started the benchmark) * Reapplied with Thermal Grizzly Kryonaut Thermal Paste: 80c Max, 70c Average I didn't download armory crate since it's a horrible program (thus why I took away 1 star).  I'm running OpenRGB and FanControl to handle thos functions.
